about_the_game:
A gentle story that blossoms with the memories of spring.

In a quiet season, one person begins to reconnect with the world they once knew—

Set in a small town where reality and daydreams softly blur, this visual novel invites you on a quiet, emotional journey.

As the scenery slowly changes, you embark on a journey to face the feelings you once forgot—

searching for something that surely existed, somewhere in the past.

With warm, light-filled visuals and delicate music, the story unfolds through the choices you make, shaping different forms of the heart.

We've all felt something we couldn’t quite put into words—

Maybe the answer is waiting in the spring breeze.

◆ Highlights of the Game ◆

・A heartfelt story that blends tenderness and sorrow, sure to leave a deep impression.

・A tale that walks the line between love and something more—perfect for all visual novel fans.

・Brought to life by an all-star voice cast, adding rich emotion to every scene.

・Don’t miss the theme song “Melody of the Night Sky” sung by Rin Kurusu, the voice actor of Cherry!

・Every scene is fully voiced—including side characters!

・Beautiful artwork and soothing music that gently resonate with your heart.

◆Character & Cast Introduction◆

■Cherry

A spirit of the cherry tree who suddenly appears before the main character.

She longs for the main character to live a peaceful, happy life.

As a third-class high ranked spirit from the spirit world, her voice has the power to stir hearts—and even create miracles.

■CV. Rin Kurusu

Cherry, the mysterious spirit of the cherry tree who suddenly appears before the protagonist, is voiced by Rin Kurusu—known for her role as Hime Anyoji in Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club and for performing the ending theme of That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 3.

Let her sweet voice and the game’s touching theme song “Melody of the Night Sky” melt your heart.

■Wathy

A spirit born from nature itself, who has protected the main character’s town for centuries.

As a second-class high ranked spirit, she keeps a close eye on Cherry to make sure nothing goes wrong.

Though serious about her role, she’s curious about human culture… and secretly loves ketchup.

■CV. Saku Mizuno

Wathy, the spirit of the lake and Cherry’s overseer, is a high-ranking spirit from the spirit world—yet oddly fascinated by human culture. She’s voiced by Saku Mizuno, known for iconic roles like Ryo Yamada in Bocchi the Rock! and Ryuu Jusetsu in Raven of the Inner Palace.

Wathy’s mix of tsundere charm and curiosity is brought to life in a performance you won’t forget.

■Yuri Takai

The main character’s childhood friend—smart, athletic, and the class rep.

She’s dependable and always looking out for the main character, even if she can be a bit bossy.

She cared for the main character since they were kids, but as Cherry grows closer with him, her feelings start to get complicated.

■CV. Yurina Uchiyama

Yuri Takai, the athletic class representative and model honor student, is voiced by Yurina Uchiyama—known for her role as Haruna Mutsuishi in CUE! and as a member of the voice acting unit DIALOGUE+.

Her energetic and heartfelt portrayal brings Yuri’s bright personality to life, especially in those rare, tender moments.

■Shoko Ina

The main character’s landlady and homeroom teacher.

She’s calm, sharp-tongued, and has a mature air, but always keeps an on the main character.

Like an older sister, she knows when to push—and when to playfully tease.

■CV. Non Harusaki

Ms. Shoko Ina, who plays both the landlady of the main character's home and their homeroom teacher, is voiced by Non Harusaki, known for roles like Misuzu Hataya in Gakuen Idolmaster and Asagao Fujita in Assault Lily: Last Bullet. She’s like a big sister—sometimes caring, sometimes strict—but always someone who gives the protagonist the push they need.

■Yua Orihara

Classmate and another childhood friend of the main character.

Soft-spoken and kind, but quietly strong at heart.

She naturally cares for others and supports the main character in her own way.

■CV. Manatsu Murakami

Yua Orihara, a gentle, quiet classmate of the protagonist, is voiced by Manatsu Murakami, known for playing Komichi Akebi in Akebi’s Sailor Uniform and a member of the voice actor unit DIALOGUE+. She supports the protagonist in her own quiet way, always there in the background.

■Hayato Kusanagi

A cheerful, sporty classmate who lights up the room.

He’s a basketball ace, but also a true friend who’s always got the main character’s back.

Loyal, energetic, and full of heart.

■CV. Kakeru Hatano

Hayato Kusanagi, the cheerful, fun-loving class clown, is voiced by Kakeru Hatano, known for playing Nijiro Nanase in Blue Lock vs. U-20 JAPAN and Tamon Fukuhara in Tamon's B-Side. He may act silly, but his light-hearted talk can lift anyone’s spirits.

He’s that kind of bright, energizing presence!
